# CSS Zero Showcase

> Recipes for CSS Zero, a Rails gem that copies plain CSS, Stimulus controllers, and SVG icons into your app. It has no view helpers: you add a component's files with a generator, then copy its markup into your views.

## Building a component

1. **Find the recipe.** Open the component's link below. It returns JSON with one entry per variant. Download the variant's markup from its `download_url`.
2. **Add the files.** Run `bin/rails generate css_zero:add <name>`, where `<name>` is the link text, for example `bin/rails generate css_zero:add dialog`.
3. **Add what the markup uses.** If the markup uses classes or a `data-controller` from another component, add that component too. For example, `icon icon--x` needs `icons`. A missing component gives no error, so the element just looks or works wrong.
4. **Paste the markup.** Change the ids, text, and URLs. Keep the classes and the `data-controller`, `data-action`, `commandfor`, and `command` attributes.
5. **Style with Foundations.** Use the classes in `utilities` for layout, spacing, and typography, and the CSS variables in the other Foundations files for custom values. Do not hard-code colors or sizes.

Some recipes are not installer names:

- `aspect_ratio`, `empty`, `infinite_scroll`, `scroll_area` use only utilities, so there is nothing to add.
- `checkbox` needs `input table`.
- `radio` needs `input list`.

## Foundations

Raw CSS files. `utilities` defines the utility classes. The other files define design tokens as CSS variables.

* [animations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lazaronixon/css-zero/master/app/assets/stylesheets/css-zero/animations.css)
* [borders](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lazaronixon/css-zero/master/app/assets/stylesheets/css-zero/borders.css)
* [colors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lazaronixon/css-zero/master/app/assets/stylesheets/css-zero/colors.css)
* [effects](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lazaronixon/css-zero/master/app/assets/stylesheets/css-zero/effects.css)
* [filters](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lazaronixon/css-zero/master/app/assets/stylesheets/css-zero/filters.css)
* [sizes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lazaronixon/css-zero/master/app/assets/stylesheets/css-zero/sizes.css)
* [transforms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lazaronixon/css-zero/master/app/assets/stylesheets/css-zero/transforms.css)
* [transitions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lazaronixon/css-zero/master/app/assets/stylesheets/css-zero/transitions.css)
* [typography](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lazaronixon/css-zero/master/app/assets/stylesheets/css-zero/typography.css)
* [utilities](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lazaronixon/css-zero/master/app/assets/stylesheets/css-zero/utilities.css)
